topic: Compile-Time vs. Runtime Polymorphism with `std::variant` and its Implementation Details
explanation: This explores the implementation differences between compile-time polymorphism achieved using `std::variant` and runtime polymorphism using virtual functions.  We'll delve into how compilers handle `std::variant`'s internal storage, the impact on memory layout and access, and the resulting performance characteristics compared to virtual function calls.  The focus will be on the trade-offs between compile-time safety and runtime flexibility.
